chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Karkhi, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Maymun, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used to seek guidance (for healing or benefit) from the water of Zamzam while he was in Medina.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet do with the water of Zamzam while in Medina?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) use of Zamzam water for *istihda* (seeking specific benefit or healing) during his time in Medina, distinguishing it from mere drinking. In Shia tradition, this establishes the permissibility and virtue of utilizing Zamzam water for spiritual and physical remedies, reflecting the broader concept of *shifa* (healing) found in the Sunnah. The placement in the chapter on *kaffarah* (expiation) may also subtly link the purifying nature of the water to the restoration of state after ritual transgression.
